summary: Summary tiles now have bold colors, tinted backgrounds, and colored shadows
whatsNew: Each summary tile now has a tinted background, full-strength colored border, and a colored drop shadow — each tile is visually distinct at a glance
Empty tiles (count = 0) use a dashed border and faded tint to clearly distinguish them from tiles with data
Populated tiles use a solid bold border with a glow shadow in their own accent color
